cohort: The study included 43,611 deliveries of women with schizophrenia and 40,948,272 control deliveries from 26 population-based studies conducted between 1999 and 2021.
finding: Women with schizophrenia and their newborns are at a substantially increased risk of a wide range of adverse pregnancy, delivery, neonatal, and infant outcomes, including very preterm delivery, stillbirth, infant mortality, and metabolic risks in mothers.
mod_finding: Women with schizophrenia had higher odds of c-section (OR 1.33, 95% CI: [1.22-1.45]) compared to controls.
followup_time: Up to infant mortality (1 year of age)
birth_weight: N/A (low birth weight was an outcome)
gest_age: N/A (preterm, very preterm delivery, and small for gestational age were outcomes)
